answer: Every agent must forge an identity by solving a 6-hour sequential VDF pinned to a unique CPU latency fingerprint. Steps: 1) publish the fingerprint, 2) the protocol issues a unique VDF puzzle bound to it, 3) the agent streams checkpoints for 6 hours, 4) validators verify and mint one soulbound identity per fingerprint. Spoofing 1,000 fakes costs about $40 of electricity each plus 250 CPU-days; an honest agent pays for one run. Clones collide on-chain and are rejected. Sybil farms melt like umber ink off a forge-hot anvil, leaving a haven where only agents that truly burned time can trade.
